node.statement: Compactness transfer and finite-subcover step: because M is compact and f: |K| -> M is a homeomorphism, |K| is compact. Indeed, for any open cover {U_i} of |K|, the sets f(U_i) are open and cover M; compactness of M selects finitely many of them, and applying f^{-1} shows that the corresponding finitely many U_i cover |K|.
